name: Papa Kuhn's Arizona Chili
author: Papa Kuhn
steps: Dice onions (amount to suit your taste, usually 1 - 1 1/2).
Splice peppers (4-6 jalapeños). The thinner the better.
Brown turkey. At very end add peppers and onions.
If you have a blender, place can of whole tomatoes in blender and momentarily turn on. Do not liquify, just chop. No blender, chop by hand. Add to chili.
Add chili powder to suit your taste. Usually about four tablespoons.
While simmering, add flour to thicken
Simmer for a couple of hours.
This is best if allowed to set overnight in refrigerator and served the next day.
